visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a close-up of two orange gym handles with black textured grips lying on a dark padded bench. Lighting is bright studio-style, casting soft shadows on the floor. (2) A muscular man's hand with tattoos on the wrist grips one of the orange handles attached to a silver barbell. He wears grey athletic shorts. (3) The man uses both hands to snap an orange handle onto a black pull-up bar rack. The background features structural gym beams and bright overhead lights. (4) View from behind at a low angle shows the man in a black t-shirt performing a pull-up on the rack. His back muscles are highly defined. (5) A hand attaches a black handle with a fabric strap to a metal carabiner on a cable machine. (6) The man is seen sitting on a gym bench, performing cable rows. He is smiling with effort, showing his facial features and muscular physique in grey shorts and socks. (7) Close-up shot of a black metal component with a silver plate engraved with text. (8) Medium close-up focusing on the man's face and massive upper arm; he looks off-camera with a focused, serious expression. (9) A quick sequence of shots shows the black fabric handle and then the orange metal handle in detail against the gym background.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main muscular male character featured throughout the workout sequence.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A professional bodybuilder with extremely large muscle mass, wearing a black athletic t-shirt and grey shorts. He has tattoos on his hands and forearms.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A professional fitness facility equipped with high-end weightlifting racks, silver barbells, cable machines, and padded benches. The flooring is dark rubberized matting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy hip-hop music featuring a heavy trap bassline and clear male rap vocals begins immediately. The track has a professional, aggressive production quality with prominent synthesized percussion. (2) A sharp, metallic mechanical click is audible as a gym handle is attached to a bar, occurring simultaneously with the heavy beat. (3) The music continues its relentless rhythmic pattern; the rapper delivers lines with a confident, medium-arousal tone. (4) Another subtle metallic clink is heard as the athlete adjusts the cable equipment. Background room tone of the gym is almost entirely masked by the dominant music track.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Feature Tease -> Practical Application -> Brand Identity
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To demonstrate the multi-functional utility and durability of FREE 360 fitness handles by showing an elite athlete using them for various upper-body exercises in a gym setting.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The equipment features prominent branding, and the entire video is structured to highlight the specific product's design and use case.
